mapper.select: SELECT member_id, login_id, password_hash, display_name, email, role, status, failed_login_count, locked_until FROM member_account WHERE lower(login_id) = lower(#{loginId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_account WHERE lower(login_id) = lower(#{loginId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_account WHERE lower(email) = lower(#{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_account ( login_id, password_hash, display_name, email, role, status ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{email}, 'USER', 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.update: UPDATE member_account SET failed_login_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member_account SET failed_login_count = failed_login_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
